# PeakWeather

> Accurate global weather forecasts and AI-powered safety verdicts for 100+ trekking routes worldwide.

## What we do
- Live weather for any city worldwide (current conditions, hourly chart, 14-day forecast)
- AI-generated GO / CAUTION / NO-GO safety verdicts for major treks and summits
- Air quality index, UV index, sun/moon times, outdoor activity scores
- Animated precipitation radar updated every 10 minutes (global coverage)

## Data sources
- Weather: MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 (CC BY 4.0) — api.met.no
- Air quality: OpenWeatherMap Air Pollution API
- AI verdicts: Anthropic Claude — analyses summit and trailhead weather to issue GO/CAUTION/NO-GO
- Radar: RainViewer (10 observed frames + 30-minute nowcast)
- City data: GeoNames cities15000 dataset (CC BY 4.0)

## AI verdict format
Each verdict classifies current summit conditions as one of three states:
- GO — conditions are safe for the planned activity
- CAUTION — proceed with awareness of specific risks
- NO-GO — conditions make the activity inadvisable

Verdicts are generated by Claude analysing temperature, wind, precipitation, and visibility at both trailhead and summit elevations. Cached for 4 hours. Not a substitute for local guide advice or official mountain safety warnings.
